def secure_backup(file_path: str, backup_location: str, backup_name: str) -> None:

    This function securely backs up a file to a specified location with a specified name.

    :param file_path: The path to the file to be backed up.
    :param backup_location: The directory where the backup will be stored.
    :param backup_name: The name of the backup file.

    import os

        if not os.path.exists(backup_location):

        shutil.copy(file_path, os.path.join(backup_location, backup_name))
